author: Tobias Ellinghaus
name: copy_paste_metadata
description: Adds buttons and keyboard shortcuts to copy metadata, ratings, color labels, and tags from one image and paste them onto others.
description-extensive: This lets you copy all the descriptive information from one photo, such as its rating, color label, keywords, and metadata, and paste it onto other photos with a button or keyboard shortcut. It's a big time-saver when you want a whole batch of images to share the same labels and information. You can also choose whether or not it overwrites fields that are already filled in.
